verdicts.reason: A rearranges sensibly for 300x250: quote and attribution on the left, can on the purple circle at right, logo bottom-left. Its only flaws are the attribution sitting tight under the quote and slightly small text. B flips the hierarchy: the attribution is set larger and bolder than the quote, the quote mark has shrunk to a speck, the logo is oversized and pushed top-right, and a small can is jammed under the text in the centre while the right half sits empty.

A shrinks the Solstice can to an unreadable orange sliver crammed against the logo at the bottom, so the key product image is effectively lost; its attribution is also bolder and larger than the quote. B has the same inverted hierarchy, an oversized logo top-right and a small, awkwardly centred can, but it is less bad because the product at least stays recognisable.
